summary: ```# Introduction to New Features in Marvelous Designer 2024.2 ## Maintaining Collision Effects During Simulation Hello everyone! In the 2024.2 version, the copy can maintain the collision effect during simulation. ### New Functions Added Right-click to copy and select the added simulation-related functions in the menu. Three functions have been added: **freeze**, **activate**, and **anti-activate**. ### Hook Activation and Simulation Participation Please note that when the hook is activated, the copy will participate in the simulation and conflict with the board, which will heavily affect its behavior. ### Adjusting Position During Simulation When the model is simulated, you can adjust its position by pressing the mouse button and holding down the copy button. After activating the simulation for the two hooks, you can observe that the weight of the hook affects the material of the package. ### Material Dynamics When dragging the copy, you can see that the material of the package will also move along with it. Compositions such as the hook or loop type are usually utilized in the simulation. ### Stability in Simulation In this case, please reduce the conflict beast to achieve a more stable simulation effect. The scale of the scale can be changed as you go through the simulation. ### Weight Adjustment When the simulation is activated, you can adjust the weight of the object. Go to the object window, find the object type, and then access the attribute editor to modify it. ### Conclusion Thank you for your attention! ```
